note: Held tier-5 English Wikipedia compilation for the ASCOD. The registry marks primary_held false because the article is a secondary compilation. The entry is the Spanish Pizarro variant. It publishes the Pizarro weight, the overall length, width and height, the engine named only as a diesel, the engine rating of 600 hp for Pizarro phase 1 and the road speed. It publishes no ground clearance, no operational range, no track shoe width, no track pitch and no grouser statement, so the entry is not runtime-ready.
